metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Pants | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom flame resistant pants for safety and branding. Perfect Imprints offers durable FR pants with your logo. Order bulk today.
introHtml: Flame resistant pants are essential for workers in welding, electrical, and oil and gas industries where arc flash or flash fire risks are present. Unlike standard work pants, FR pants are made from inherently flame-resistant fabrics like Nomex or treated cotton that self-extinguish upon exposure to flames. By adding your company logo via screen printing or embroidery, you reinforce safety compliance while promoting your brand on the job site.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant pants with embroidered logo, featuring durable FR fabric and reinforced knees for industrial safety.
